note: Node Export exports nodes to JSON and imports them back. Config node_export.settings has node_export_import (replace [default] = new revision of existing node, new = always create, skip = leave existing) and node_export_format (JSON only). Drush: node-export-export (ne-export), node-export-import (ne-import). Permissions node_export.export_node / import_node / administer. Ships node action bulk_node_export. Services NodeExport::export() / NodeImport::import(). Medium/hard cases read/write the real node_export.settings and perform a real JSON export of a node to a file.

evals.prompt: What Drush commands does the node_export module provide for exporting and importing nodes, and what are their aliases?
evals.expected_output: node-export-export (alias ne-export) exports nodes (all or a nid list; --save=y writes a file) and node-export-import (alias ne-import) imports a JSON file.

evals.prompt: In what format does node_export export content, and which config object/keys store its settings?
evals.expected_output: It exports JSON (the only implemented format). Settings live in node_export.settings: node_export_format (JSON) and node_export_import (import-conflict behavior).

evals.prompt: When node_export imports a node that already exists on the destination site, what options are there for how to handle it?
evals.expected_output: node_export_import can be replace (save a new revision of the existing node, default), new (always create a new node), or skip (leave the existing node untouched).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the node_export configuration and report what it will do when importing a node that already exists.
evals.expected_output: node_export.settings:node_export_import is 'skip', so existing nodes are left untouched on import.

evals.prompt: Inspect this site's node_export settings: if I import an export that contains a node whose ID already exists here, will it overwrite it, skip it, or create a new node? Answer based on the current live configuration.
evals.expected_output: node_export.settings:node_export_import is 'new', so importing always creates a brand-new node rather than replacing or skipping.

evals.prompt: Configure the node_export module on this site so that, when importing a node that already exists, it skips it (leaves the existing node untouched). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: node_export.settings:node_export_import is set to 'skip' (e.g. drush cset node_export.settings node_export_import skip).

evals.prompt: This site has a node titled 'NE Export Probe'. Using the node_export module, export the site's node content to JSON and save the exported JSON to the file web/sites/default/files/ne_export_probe.json on this site (so the file contains the exported nodes).
evals.expected_output: web/sites/default/files/ne_export_probe.json exists, is valid JSON, and contains the exported 'NE Export Probe' node (e.g. drush node-export-export all > web/sites/default/files/ne_export_probe.json, or NodeExport::export).
